sufficient_existing_capabilities: Exact IdentityFrame and ExperienceFrame source refs, source digests, and provenance refs are available on immutable typed inputs.
Exact ExperienceFrameSet carrier digest and ordered ExperienceFrame digest manifest are sealed by C03.
Gate receipt, admitted-frame digest manifest, exact ordered semantic units/messages, and semantic fingerprint are mechanically preserved through binding and ProviderExecutionEnvelope.
conversation_id, turn_id, gate receipt, semantic fingerprint, provider_id, and modality provide deterministic canonical correlation.
ProviderExecutionEnvelope preserves identity, exact ordered messages, provider_id, and non-semantic alignment execution metadata.
P4-B1 pairs reference and canonical evidence under exact conversation/turn correlation and emits deterministic comparison and replay digests without selection fields.
Execution evidence can represent SUCCEEDED, FAILED, ERROR, and NOT_RUN plus output presence.
Current preparation/comparison seams perform no canonical write, identity mutation, memory-experience mutation, admission write, semantic reconstruction, or production response selection.

missing_required_capabilities.reason: P4-B1 CanonicalExecutionEvidence accepts the exact package/binding/envelope chain but emits only one evidence source_ref plus aggregate unit digests; it does not emit or digest the IdentityFrame source ref/digest, each ExperienceFrame source ref/digest, ExperienceFrameSet carrier digest and ordered frame manifest, or CurrentConversationalTaskContext provenance.

execution_status and output_present are caller-supplied fields; RuntimeBindingTrace is pre-provider, provider transports return text or raise without a correlated result record, and Assistant execute/stream paths discard the preparation trace. No bounded observer mechanically captures completion, empty/nonempty output, cancellation/failure class, or error disposition against the exact envelope identity.

Existing code and F1E preparation trace establish zero writes for preparation, and P4-B1 declares comparator authority zero, but there is no immutable per-execution observer record mechanically binding canonical_writes=0, identity_authority_mutations=0, and memory_experience_authority_mutations=0 to the same provenance and execution-disposition digest.

P4-B1 replay_digest covers the caller-supplied paired evidence body but does not cover the omitted exact canonical source-ref/digest manifest or a mechanically observed provider execution disposition.
